description:
The Bazecor configurator software allows you to remap any key and create up to 10 fully programmable layers for your Dygma Raise keyboard. It also allows you to create and manage superkeys, macros, and shortcuts.


Hi, Everybody
Small Bazecor update today to get ready for the first Dygma Sonsei keyboards that we've already shipped:
- Added new Sonsei pictures for the Keyboard Manager and Settings menu
- Added new Dygma Sonsei virtual keyboards so you can configure your layout while waiting to receive it
Enjoy your new Dygma Sonsei keyboards!
